title: Predicting EGFR gene mutation in lung adenocarcinoma using spectral CT combined with AI parameters: a diagnostic accuracy study.
summary: CT spectral and CNN-derived radiomic features modeled EGFR genotype in 150 pathologically confirmed lung adenocarcinomas; the combined logistic model reached AUC 0.713. This is a single-center retrospective diagnostic association without external validation.
